{{Quote|To spare the galaxy bloodshed and pain, we tried to stop the war in its earliest stages, by bringing the fight to Ossus, away from the Republic worlds. We failed, and the Jedi pursued us into the Core.|Filed selections from the debriefing of Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the faction of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]–adherents known as the [[Legions of Lettow]] as part of the [[First Great Schism]] in [[24,500 BBY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] repulsed the Lettow attack and subsequently pursued them to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and, according to a legend, the battleground on Ossus became the site of the structure known as the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]].

==Prelude==
In [[24,500 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> disagreements arose between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] splinter faction known as the [[Legions of Lettow]], members of which advocated using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==The battle==
Eventually, open conflict—which came to be known as the [[First Great Schism]]—between the two organizations became unavoidable. The Legions of Lettow, [[Commander/Legends|led]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xendor]] and his lover, [[Arden Lyn]], decided to take the fight to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the remote headquarters of the Jedi Order, to prevent the worlds of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from being drawn into a potentially [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] war. The Jedi, however, repulsed the Lettow attack.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Aftermath==
The Jedi subsequently pursued the Legionnaires to the Republic-controlled [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], which was followed by engagements at [[Battle of Chandrila (First Great Schism)|Chandrila]], [[Battle of Brentaal IV (First Great Schism)|Brentaal IV]], [[Battle of Coruscant (First Great Schism)|Coruscant]], and [[Battle of Metellos (First Great Schism)|Metellos]]. Lyn was eventually [[Duel on Irkalla|placed]] into a state of [[Morichro/Legends|stasis]] that lasted until [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], she was awakened by agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and she mentioned the battle on Ossus in a debriefing, selections of which were filed by<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Laddinare Torbin]].<ref name="Gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

[[File:GreatJediLibrary_EGTF.jpg|thumb|right|300px|According to legend, the Eye of Ashlanae was erected on the site of the Ossus battle.]]
According to a legend that existed by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the site of the battle on Ossus took on sacred importance to the Jedi Order. In the planet's [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]], the Jedi survivors of the First Great Schism allegedly each carved a block of stone the size of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]<ref name="NoP" />—a creature from the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] averaging 2.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>—and, over the span of several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitated]] them to the site of the battle.<ref name="NoP" />

There, the Jedi further shaped and fitted the boulders, constructing the fifty meter–tall ziggurat-shaped structure known as the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]] as a monument to their comrades who had perished in the battle. It was also said that a simple stone platform situated at the center of a chamber that was located deep beneath the structure coincided with the spot where the last blow of the First Great Schism was landed<ref name="NoP" />—although the conflict had actually ended with the Jedi forces being [[Battle of Lettow|victorious]] over the Lettow at<ref name="EGTW" /> the Core planet of the [[Lettow|same name]].<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the Jedi Order deliberated on various issues at the chamber, and the stone platform was also supposedly a powerful [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="NoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Ossus was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
